name: Whirlpool🌟
description:
Throws fly straight and pull enemies, then slam down and form a suffocating whirlpool.

A mythical enchantment found on the relic [blue]Charybdis[/blue].

[dark-green]Messina[/dark-green] is a trident, [blue]Charybdis[/blue], whose throws leave [orange]Scylla[/orange] in your hand.
